description: Four square-wave blips, each with its own trigger and pitch knob, mixed to one output

params.text: Sets the frequency of that blip, between 1000Hz and 5000Hz

inputs.text: A gate above 0.5V sounds that blip
Raises all four blips by one octave per volt over 0 to 5V, with the result held below 5000Hz

inputs.0: high above 0.5V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 0.5V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 0.5V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 0.5V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.4:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
